items.title: Nicotine Vape Legality, Control Under MOH’s Jurisdiction: KPDN
items.summary: KPDN says the legality and control of nicotine vape fall under MOH's jurisdiction, not Domestic Trade, because nicotine is "classified as an active chemical substance and poison that directly affects public health, not an ordinary trade commodity". items.title: Vape Industry Flags Massive Potential Legal, Commercial Consequences After Government Drops Nicotine Appeal
items.summary: Mevta says if Putrajaya decides that nicotine vape is illegal, after it dropped its appeal, there must be a minimum 6-month transition period for the entire supply chain (from raw liquid nicotine stock to retail vape sale) and refund of excise duties paid.
